name: durable-mutation-preserves-transient-pairing
body:
After a durable node/edge mutation, the projection must still contain every pre-existing TRANSIENT pairing incident to a changed FQN. A durable write's delta is computed from the durable `apg/layers/` tree alone, but `db.lbug` is the projection of durable layers + plan store + ALL transient tier mirrors; the durable apply must therefore re-merge the assembled transient records (or otherwise not drop transient pairings incident to changed FQNs). Concretely, a pre-existing `Feedback-[:Reviews]->node` edge on a changed node must survive a durable write — with no transient write in between to restore it — so `apg review list` and the verify gate's "all feedback resolved" / feedback-attachment checks are not skewed.

Acceptance: after a durable `apg node update` (or `apg edge add|update|rm`) on a node carrying a pre-existing `Feedback-[:Reviews]` edge, an immediate `apg_query` in a new process still returns that edge — with no `apg scan` and no `apg plan`/`apg review` write in between.
